title: Generative AI Application Development - Part 1
description: Generative AI application development covering LLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, AI agents, chatbots, and document processing with LangChain/LangGraph. This submodule covers: LLM APIs, Prompt engineering, Tokens, Context, Structured outputs.
learning_outcomes: Work with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) and manage tokens/context
Implement prompt engineering for structured outputs
Use function calling and tools with AI models
